responsibility: This file implements D-specific GCC driver behavior for command-line processing and link setup. It scans decoded options to recognize D source inputs and D-only flags, decides when and how libphobos/druntime and libstdc++ should be linked, rewrites or suppresses certain driver options, synthesizes a default `-o` so multiple D sources are compiled in one frontend invocation, and loads the D runtime linker spec before linking when required.
